title: August Wilhelm Ambros Musikaufsätze und -rezensionen 1872–1876, Bd. 2: 1874–1876
summary: The present edition of musical essays and reviews by August Wilhelm Ambros (1816–1876) covers the years 1872–1876—a time that Ambros spent as a music reviewer for the Wiener Zeitung in Vienna. The second volume contains, in total, 126 essays from the years 1874–1876. It documents not only Ambros’ position within Viennese music criticism of the 1870s, but also an important chapter in European musical history.
